About Me

Ch. 1 · What do you want to be?

0:00-:--

The written version

About me: to be continued…

01 — What do you want to be?

Everyone asks it. As a kid you give the cute answer; as a teenager, the safe one. For a long time I had a tidy answer ready. But as the 21-year-old Avira, my idea of ambition has changed.

02 — I want to be…

I want to be well read. I want to know about art, the kind that hangs in museums and the kind that lives in feeds. I also want to do fun stuff: good coffee, long conversations, rooms full of strangers who turn into friends.

03 — The education part

At 21, I have basically completed a postgraduate program at Hive School of Business, alongside my Bachelor's in Business Administration. So I guess I'm halfway… halfway to wherever this is going. The degrees taught me how businesses work; writing for brands, running other people's socials, interning and then building a brand of my own taught me why people care. That's where the two started making sense together.

04 — The brand part

Somewhere between the sentences I wrote for other people's brands and the first reel I posted for my own, I figured out what I love: the story behind a brand. Content calendars that make a feed feel like a show. Campaign ideas that start conversations. Toemahtoe, my D2C sock brand, was the proof of concept: ₹62K on launch day, a 16K+ organic-view first reel and 200+ pairs in B2B orders.

05 — So, yes.

That's the playbook so far. About me? To be continued… and if your brand has a story waiting to be told, I'd love to help write the next chapter.
